To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a 80 kcal low dose whey protein and guar preload can reduce glucose after a carbohydrate meal in people with predia-betes or type 2 diabetes.
an 80-kcal whey protein and guar gum preload can lower average blood glucose over 3 h by 0.7-0.8 mmol/L in people with pred diabetes and in those with well-controlled type 2 diabetes.
an 80 kcal whey protein/fiber preload can lower glucose over 3 hours by 0.9 mmol/L in people with diabetes and prediabetes.
